name: Medeber Market (Medebar)
subtitle: An open-air workshop market where metalworkers and other artisans turn scrap and discarded materials into household items.

parts.text: An open-air workshop market where metalworkers and other artisans turn scrap and discarded materials into household items. Eritrean Ministry of Information articles describe it as a former caravan trade post; whether it lies inside the UNESCO-inscribed perimeter is not confirmed by a readable source.
